title: 21st Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/21/2/2025).
First reading of the Bill amending the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilimale MP Mohamed Ismail.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the National Payment System Act (Law No. 8/2021), submitted on behalf of the government by Makunudhoo MP Adam Shafeeq.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Water and Sewerage Act (Law No. 8/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Hulhumale South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed seeking members' views on the high cost of electricity and water for small and medium businesses operating outside Male.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the Bill amending the Penal Code (Law No. 9/2014), submitted by Galolhu South MP Meekail Ahmed Naseem.
Report of the Judiciary Committee on the President's nomination of Al-Ustaz Abdul Ghanee Mohamed (H. Hostside) as Chief Justice under Article 147 of the Constitution.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting introduced the Tax Administration Act amendment, debated the National Payment System amendment, continued three unfinished debates, and took up the Judiciary Committee report on the Chief Justice nominee.
